question: Among EUR-paying customers in segments SME, LAM, and KAM, what is the difference in absolute year-over-year consumption growth (2013 minus 2012) between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?

    SELECT 
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_2013

    INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
